title: Chronological Escalation from First Combo to 64-Orb Climax

clips.why: Skips tutorial text and immediately teaches aim-and-drop with a COMBO x2! into 16.
Triggers BIG MERGE! into a 32-orb and unlocks the Bomb power-up.
Pays off the unlock with a satisfying Bomb explosion clearing the stack.
Builds the board with a 16-orb merge into another 32-orb.
Introduces SPEED UP! faster drops mode alongside a combo chain.
Delivers the full 64-orb COMBO x2! (+128) climax and Bomb refill.
Closes on the ORB MERGE end card and PLAY NOW button.
